description: Phase 6: Vietnamese plant, object, decoration models and house/structure templates (Blockbench + Aseprite), integrated into map generator placement tables. Depends on FEAT-004; independent of FEAT-005.
steps: Read .agents/inbox.md, then implement plan.md items 6.1-6.4 in order exactly as written in /projects/sandbox/Forzacraft/.agents/tasks/forzacraft/plan.md (files, behaviour, verification per item).
After each completed item: run its Verify command, then git add the specific files, commit (conventional message) and git push origin main.
Any point needing a user decision: append a question to .agents/questions.md, send_message severity 'info', mark the item DEFERRED (Qn) in plan.md, continue with other items.

Finish with the Phase 6 DONE CHECK: bash tools/ci/done-check.sh (and COMPAT=server bash tools/ci/server-smoke.sh where the plan says so); record command outputs summary, test counts, screenshot paths in findings.
acceptance_criteria: every model has a viewed screenshot
